lines: Once we pass under the overpass
Blue peeks through the gaps in the clouds
It's been so hot lately
So I just waited for the wind to blow
I sit in the shade of the trees
Something lands on my cheek
Looking up, blossoms bloom overhead and scatter
Drifting down — we've already forgotten to breathe
Even blinking feels like too much effort
Come now, even today will turn to yesterday, to the past
I just wait for the wind
So we've already forgotten even our voices
Even saying goodbye feels like too much effort
The flowers simply fall
The sky clears
Now, a blizzard of spring blossoms
The next day we meet again
The flower-viewing crowds have thinned
The scent of spring is already fading
Is summer coming again this year?
Once we pass under the overpass
You come into view at the end of the road
How much is left, I wonder
How much longer will I get to meet spring
The hill along the river
I sit in the shade of the trees
Unchanged from yesterday, today they bloom again
The flowers do
We've already forgotten to breathe
Even blinking feels like too much effort
This storm now blowing, scattering the blossoms
Is truly a thief of spring
In the wind, time flows on again today
Even standing feels like too much effort
Through gaps in the blossoms, the sky
They scatter
Still, a blizzard of spring blossoms
Today too, I go to see you
I sit in the shade of the trees
I let out a sigh
The flowers are almost over
Tomorrow too, I'll come to see you
Spring is almost over
As if lingering, time scatters away
Sing of love, and words fall short
Even keeping the rhyme feels like too much effort
Could mere words ever tell of this moment in bloom?
Drifting down — we've already forgotten even our voices
Even blinking feels like too much effort
The flower-viewing is ours alone
Don't fall yet, blizzard of spring blossoms
Just a little longer
Only a few left to count now
Just two blossoms more
Just one blossom left now
Only the leaves remain
Drifting down
Now, spring takes its bow
